title: Samsung is now charging up to 15% more for the chips it makes, insiders say
description: The AI boom has gobbled up manufacturing capacity on TSMC’s leading-edge fabs, so companies are turning to Samsung to make their chips – and this has given the company enough leverage to increase its prices by up to 15%, say insiders who spoke to Reuters. In July, Samsung started charging US and Chinese customers 10-15% more for its 4nm node, called SF4, than it did the month before. Companies from Taiwan are looking at 5-10% higher bills. And it’s not just the relatively recent 4nm node that got pricier – SF5 (5nm) also costs 10-15% more, while the rather old 8nm node is now almost 10%...

title: The big three US carriers are offering some Pixel 11 models for free, here is what you need to know
description: The Google Pixel 11 series is now available in stores and from carriers in select regions, following a week of pre-orders. Here’s a look at what the big three US carriers have to offer. T-Mobile is offering the three non-folding models for free – or as the carrier puts it “get the Pixel 11 Pro XL on Us”. This means that it’s $1,300 off, making the base model free. You need to add a new line or trade in an old device (in any condition) and sign up for Experience Beyond 2.0 and Go5G Next. The actual discount will come in the form of credits to your monthly bill (up to 36...

title: Honor 700 series details leak alongside information about the Magic9, Win2, and Power3
description: Today the prolific leaker who goes by Digital Chat Station on Weibo has shared some new information about Honor's upcoming device ranges. The Magic9 Pro, expected to be unveiled next month, will have two 200MP cameras with some mystery Arri capabilities. The Honor Win2 series will come with a flat screen with "2K" resolution and a 10,000 mAh battery. The built-in cooling fan that debuted on the original Win is staying. The Honor Power3 will come with a 7-inch screen and the industry's largest battery, apparently, so this is probably that mystery device that's been in testing with a...

title: iQOO Z11 hands-on
description: iQOO today unveiled the iQOO Z11 in India after weeks of promo campaigns. However, the Z11 introduced in India has a design and specs different from the Z11 available in China and Malaysia. We spent some time with the Indian version of the iQOO Z11, and here are our first impressions. The Indian iQOO Z11 comes in a black retail box, including a transparent protective case, some documents, a SIM ejector tool, a charging cable, and a 44W power adapter. The Indian iQOO Z11 is built around a 6.83" curved AMOLED display, protected by Schott Xensation Up glass. The panel has a...

title: CMF Buds Neo goes official with ANC and up to 52 hour total battery life
description: As promised, Nothing's CMF sub-brand has unveiled its latest pair of wireless earbuds in India. The CMF Buds Neo offer a distinctive design, active noise cancellation (ANC), and a claimed 52 hours of total playback time. The CMF Buds Neo feature an in-ear design with 12.4mm dynamic drivers. Meanwhile, the charging case sports a square design with rounded corners, a circular dial, and a lanyard hole. For audio, the earbuds offer active noise cancellation (ANC) of up to 35dB, along with environmental noise cancellation (ENC) for calls. They also feature four microphones in...

title: Huawei Pura X View unveiled with a 16:9.5 wide display, 7,000mAh battery
description: Huawei's rumored non-folding smartphone with a wide aspect ratio is now official. The company has unveiled the Pura X View featuring a wide form factor and a display with a 16:9.5 aspect ratio. The Huawei Pura X View is the world's first non-folding smartphone with a wide display. In terms of design, the phone bears a resemblance to the Pura X. While Huawei has yet to reveal the complete specifications, the Pura X View features a display with a 16:9.5 aspect ratio and a resolution of 2,232 × 1,320 pixels. The panel is rated to deliver up to 6,500 nits of peak brightness, while...

title: The Google Pixel 11 series is now on sale
description: Google unveiled the Pixel 11 series last Wednesday and put the new models on pre-order – but today is the date that you can actually get one as they officially become available in stores and through carriers in select regions. Here’s the list of countries where 11-series models have launched: Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Czechia, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, India, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, United Kingdom, United States (except Puerto Rico). Note that the foldable is not available in a few...

title: Sony is launching a new Xperia phone next week
description: Sony is set to add a new member to its Xperia lineup next week. The brand announced a new Xperia launch set for Tuesday, August 25. The event will be livestreamed on YouTube and is set to begin at 11AM Japan time, which corresponds to 4 AM CEST on August 26 in Europe. Sony didn’t explicitly mention the device in question but according to recent leaks, it should be the Xperia 10 VIII (MK8). Last year’s Xperia 10 VII (MK7) launched in September, which would make the Xperia 10 VIII launch nearly a month early. According to a recent Geekbench run, the MK8 will feature the same Snapdragon 6...

title: Sony Xperia 10 VIII runs Geekbench
description: It’s been almost a year since the Xperia 10 VII (MK7) came out, and its successor just appeared in a Geekbench listing. The Sony XQ-GH54, which is expected to launch as the Xperia 10 VIII (MK8) appeared with the Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chip alongside 8GB RAM. Xperia 10 VIII (XQ-GH54) Geekbench 7 test run The Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 was announced back in 2024 and is the same chipset at the helm of last year’s Xperia 10 VII. The MK8 managed 871 points in the single-core test and 3,028 in the multi-core department. So we have a good estimate of what to expect in terms of performance. Xperia...

title: Samsung showcases a 300Hz OLED display for gaming laptops among other cutting-edge display tech
description: At the IMID 2026 expo in Busan, South Korea, Samsung unveiled several cutting-edge display technologies and arguably the standout display showcased at Samsung's booth is a 16-inch OLED panel with a 300Hz refresh rate. New high-refresh-rate OLEDs This is an industry first. We haven't seen such a high refresh rate on an OLED, but once it hits the market, it will surely be adopted by high-end gaming laptops. However, aside from the 2.5K resolution and 16:9 aspect ratio, Samsung didn't disclose further details. We can only assume that the HDR capabilities will be excellent, but peak...

title: Apple Watch Series 12 to mark the return of a long-lost material
description: According to a new rumor from a tipster on X, Apple's upcoming Apple Watch Series 12 will mark the return of ceramic as a case material. That would definitely be an interesting move from Apple, diversifying its material options for the Apple Watch while also possibly driving up the average selling price, since the ceramic model will likely be more expensive. The last Apple Watch to be offered in ceramic was the Apple Watch Edition Series 5, which was launched in 2019. That's a seven-year gap, and a long wait for fans of the material. It's still unclear if white will be the only ceramic...

title: iQOO Z11 debuts in India with different specs and design, Buds TWS tag along
description: After weeks of teasers, iQOO has officially launched the Z11 in India alongside the iQOO Buds. The Indian variant features a redesigned look and comes with a couple of hardware differences from the global models. The Indian variant of the iQOO Z11 is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7500 Turbo chipset, paired with up to 12GB of LPDDR4X RAM and up to 256GB of UFS 3.1 storage. At the front, the smartphone features a curved 6.83-inch AMOLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate, Full-HD+ resolution, and up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness. It also gets an in-display optical fingerprint...

title: Samsung is already working on the Galaxy A58 and Galaxy XCover FR
description: Samsung launched the Galaxy A57 in March, and now it's already working on its successor, the Galaxy A58. This was revealed by the GSMA Association's database. There are no details about the upcoming device yet, but it will have the model number SM-A586x, with the last digit or character indicating the market it will be available in. The model that is in the GSMA database is the SM-A5860, which is the one for the Chinese market. Additionally, the database also shows that Samsung is working on the Galaxy XCover FR, with the model number SM-G778x. The exact version in the database is the...

title: Sony WH-1000XM4C images leak along with spec details
description: Sony launched the WH-1000XM4 headphones in 2020, and they've been discontinued for a while now. However, the company is apparently working on relaunching them as the WH-1000XM4C. We first heard about this a couple of weeks or so ago, and today there's a new leak about them, so they're clearly an actual thing. Here they are in three colors. Sony WH-1000XM4C leaked images The WH-1000XM4C will allegedly support Bluetooth 6.0, which is a clear upgrade over the WH-1000XM4's Bluetooth 5.0. However, they will get a downgrade in terms of battery life, going from 30 hours with ANC on to...

title: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max may have just been certified
description: Xiaomi's upcoming 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max may have just been certified for sale in China. The two devices both support 100W wired charging, and they have UWB on board as well. They are expected to be launched in China in September, and will very likely be the first phones to use Qualcomm’s upcoming Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro SoC. Digital Chat Station on Weibo says the duo will get improved screens, cameras, performance, and peripherals. However, the vanilla Xiaomi 18 won't be joining them. Once again Xiaomi is rumored to be emulating Apple's strategy, and this time around it's not...

title: Is this a Google Pixel smartband or a new Fitbit device?
description: During Google’s big Pixel event last week, the company unveiled the Pixel 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro XL and the 11 Pro Fold, as well as the new Pixel Watch 5 and introduced its first smart tag called the Pixel Tag. There was no mention of new Fitbit devices, though (and why would there be?), nor a second smartwatch either. But Google Australia must know something that we don’t because it’s running ads that showcase an unknown smartband. The Redditors that spotted it are debating whether this is the Fitbit Charge 7, a Google Pixel Watch a-series or what. A mysterious smartband appears in...

title: iPhone 17 Pro cases may fit the iPhone 18 Pro
description: Apple is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max in the first part of next month, most likely on September 8 or 9. As we wait for the event to happen, an intriguing new prospect has emerged. The cases made for the iPhone 17 Pro may very well fit the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro. One case maker has already created packaging that lists both the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro as compatible with a specific case, as you can see in the image below. This was surfaced by Mark Gurman on X, and he notes that Best Buy is already selling these in its stores in the US. Then, the...

title: Samsung sets the date for the Galaxy S26 FE unveiling - it's coming next week
description: Samsung will introduce a new member of the Galaxy S26 family on Thursday next week (August 27) during its “Galaxy Event August 2026”, which will be livestreamed on Samsung.com and on its YouTube channel. The event starts at noon 12pm UTC. While the company doesn’t name it explicitly, this can be no other model than the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE. Unfortunately, the company doesn’t offer any official details for the new FE. description: For many, many months now it's been rumored that Qualcomm would unveil not one, but two Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 SoCs at its annual Snapdragon Summit. title: Amazon makes its Alexa+ AI chatbot free for eligible Fire TV devices
description: Back in February Amazon opened up its Alexa+ AI chatbot to everyone in the US, with Prime subscribers getting unlimited access to it for free. Today, the company is expanding the reach of the service, for free, to those who have a compatible Fire TV device. To clarify right from the start, if you have one of the following devices, you can use Alexa+ for free even without a Prime subscription: all current-generation Amazon Fire TV Sticks, the Fire TV Cube, Amazon Ember Smart TVs, and other smart TVs "by trusted brands with Alexa+ built-in" (including Hisense and Panasonic).
